text: 信息茧房的本质是共鸣（或共情）成瘾。
en: The essence of the information cocoon is addiction to resonance (or empathy).

text: 企图用认知提升，或者专业的学习是无法打破成瘾性的，就像一个认知再高、专业技能再强的人，一旦沦入毒瘾或性瘾，也很难戒掉。
en: Trying to break the addiction through cognitive improvement or professional study does not work — just as a person with high cognition and strong professional skills, once addicted to drugs or sex, finds it very hard to quit.

text: 从心理舒适度出发，人们会倾向相信那些，自己的经历、教育、社会身份、情绪回路、创伤、易构建情景等等可以共鸣的东西，而无论其是否真的有道理。
en: Out of psychological comfort, people tend to believe things that their own experience, education, social identity, emotional circuits, traumas, easily constructed scenarios and the like can resonate with, regardless of whether those things are actually reasonable.

text: 而且，人们会倾向于相信，在心理暗示上带有褒义词汇，且与自身超我匹配的描述，哪怕这个描述本身换一种说法，就是明显的悖论。
en: Moreover, people tend to believe descriptions that carry positive words under psychological suggestion and match their own superego, even if the same description, phrased differently, is an obvious paradox.

text: 由于对自己视野或认知以外的盲区缺乏基本的系统性概念，人们还会倾向于相信，用自己的经历或周边的环境结构去解释盲区的规律和结构。
en: Because they lack even a basic systematic concept of the blind spots beyond their own horizons or cognition, people also tend to believe in explaining the patterns and structures of those blind spots using their own experience or their surrounding environment's structure.

text: 这些不仅仅是心理舒适度的需求，它们还带来（融入主流群体的）安全感、（识别敌我边界的）清晰感、（自己很优秀的心理暗示带来的）社会成就感，从而生成了大量的多巴胺反馈。
en: These are not merely needs for psychological comfort; they also bring a sense of security (from blending into the mainstream group), a sense of clarity (from identifying friend-or-foe boundaries), and a sense of social achievement (from the psychological suggestion that one is excellent), thereby generating large amounts of dopamine feedback.

text: 这就导致，人们在选择信息和分析信息时，会围绕感性共鸣（或共情）来进行定义和筛选，将无法获得多巴胺的部分认定为假（或无价值的、邪恶的、不道德的、需要被消灭的），从而隔离了自洽圈和舒适圈以外的信息。
en: This causes people, when choosing and analysing information, to define and filter everything around emotional resonance (or empathy), labelling whatever yields no dopamine as false (or worthless, evil, immoral, needing to be eliminated), and thereby isolating information outside their self-consistent circle and comfort zone.

text: 同时，自洽和舒适感所带来的大量多巴胺，会阻止人们用理性和方法论去推测，表面信息背后的逻辑，以及隐藏的拼图，会习惯于条件反射的用熟悉范式（而不是理性推导）去进行认知定性。
en: At the same time, the large amounts of dopamine brought by self-consistency and comfort stop people from using reason and methodology to infer the logic behind surface information and the hidden pieces of the puzzle; they grow accustomed to using familiar paradigms (rather than rational deduction) by reflex to characterise what they perceive.

text: 综上所述，戒除共鸣（或共情）成瘾，是避免活在信息茧房中的唯一路径。
en: In summary, quitting resonance (or empathy) addiction is the only path to avoiding life inside an information cocoon.

text: 一些相对简单的训练方法：
en: Some relatively simple training methods:

text: 1，学会解析信息及其包含的逻辑的底层，通过对信息的极简化处理，去掉形容词和各种诱发情绪的褒义词，把底层逻辑暴露出来，从而在规避共鸣（或共情）的情况下进行真伪和程度性的检查。
en: 1. Learn to parse information and the underlying logic it contains: by radically simplifying the information, removing adjectives and all kinds of emotion-inducing positive words, you expose the underlying logic, and can then check truth and degree while avoiding resonance (or empathy).

text: 2，使用合订本模式，有意识的跟踪曾经对自己产生巨大共鸣，或巨大情绪刺激的信息，在热点消退和自己的情绪消退后，进行分析、复盘，寻找当时自己的共鸣点产生的原因和带来的认知偏差，以及思考如何在未来规避这种偏差。
en: 2. Use the bound-volume model: deliberately track information that once produced huge resonance in you, or huge emotional stimulation, and after the buzz fades and your emotions subside, analyse and review it, looking for the cause of your resonance at the time and the cognitive bias it brought, and thinking about how to avoid such bias in future.

text: 3，有意识的寻找你认可的信息或观点的对立面，并分析其合理性的程度。
en: 3. Deliberately seek out the opposite side of information or views you endorse, and analyse the degree of its reasonableness.

text: 4，反向代入：即不仅仅代入你条件反射的立场和角色，也代入与之对立的角色。
en: 4. Reverse role-play: that is, do not only put yourself in the position and role you reflexively take, but also in the opposing role.

text: 5，极化推断：即将信息及其逻辑，向极端化方向推演，看是否出现明显谬误，如果有这个明显谬误，再反推当前信息及其逻辑的适用范围或真伪。
en: 5. Polarisation inference: push the information and its logic toward the extreme and see whether an obvious fallacy appears; if one does, work backwards to infer the applicable scope or truth of the current information and its logic.

text: 6，非从众意识：寻找与你一样共鸣的人的共同特点和特征，并且推断，如果去掉这些特征，该信息是否还会被认可。
en: 6. Non-conformist awareness: find the common traits and features of the people who resonate the same way you do, and infer whether the information would still be endorsed if those traits were removed.

text: 以上，本文无意贬低认知提升的重要性，但在信息茧房层面，认知提升的效用非常有限，感性的认知被自洽包装成论理的辩证的认知，这种习惯非常常见，离开以上的这些训练模式，所谓的认知提升，其实很可能是自己看到更多信息数量（而非质量）之后的臆想。
en: That is all. This article does not intend to belittle the importance of cognitive improvement, but at the level of the information cocoon, cognitive improvement is of very limited use. Emotional cognition, packaged by self-consistency as logical, dialectical cognition, is a very common habit. Without the training modes above, so-called cognitive improvement is quite possibly just imagining things after seeing a greater quantity (rather than quality) of information.

text: 不要害怕信息茧房，也不要轻视他。
en: Do not fear the information cocoon, and do not underestimate it.

text: 要打破他、驾驭他、利用他。
en: Break it, master it, use it.

text: 因为越是经济不好，越容易出现巨大的信息差，大环境不好，越要反着来。
en: Because the worse the economy is, the more likely huge information gaps appear; the worse the general environment, the more you should go against the grain.

text: 花200块买国外故事大纲，AI润色写成小说，几个月赚了小几十万。
en: Spend 200 yuan buying a foreign story outline, polish it with AI into a novel, and earn hundreds of thousands of yuan in a few months.

text: 搬国外手工黏土教程，去水印翻译成中文，小红书卖99块，售出2580单。
en: Take a foreign handmade clay tutorial, remove the watermark, translate it into Chinese, and sell it on Xiaohongshu for 99 yuan — 2,580 orders sold.

text: 从国外二手市场100块淘黑胶唱片，国内卖300块，很多人加价抢。
en: Pick up a vinyl record for 100 yuan from a foreign second-hand market and sell it domestically for 300 yuan, with many people scrambling to pay extra.

text: 把国外宠物搞笑视频重新剪辑配中文解说，挂小黄车卖宠物用品，双十一纯利润小20万。
en: Re-edit foreign funny pet videos with Chinese narration, attach the yellow cart link to sell pet supplies, and make nearly 200,000 yuan in pure profit on Double 11.

text: 国外免费公开的减脂食谱，翻译整理成"中国人能执行版"，卖49元饮食模板。
en: Take a free foreign fat-loss recipe, translate and organise it into a 'version Chinese people can actually follow', and sell the diet template for 49 yuan.

text: 6.TikTok上的家居收纳玩法，国内很多中年女性第一次见，直接能做成爆款账号。
en: 6. Home storage tricks from TikTok are being seen for the first time by many middle-aged women in China, and can directly become hit accounts.

text: 国外早就玩烂的"电子数字产品"，国内很多人还停留在卖体力。
en: 'Electronic digital products' that have long been played out abroad are still unfamiliar to many people in China, who remain stuck selling physical labour.

text: 8.AI做PPT，做海报，做文案，国外已经普及，国内还有很多小老板不会用。
en: 8. Using AI to make PPTs, posters and copywriting is already widespread abroad, yet many small business owners in China still do not know how.

text: 有人专门搬运国外冷门纪录片切片，做知识账号，一条视频几十万播放。
en: Some people specialise in moving slices of obscure foreign documentaries to build knowledge accounts, with a single video getting hundreds of thousands of views.

text: 国外Etsy卖爆的手账模板，国内改成中文版继续卖。
en: Handbook templates that sell explosively on Etsy abroad get turned into Chinese versions and keep selling in China.

text: 小红书很多爆款，本质上只是把国外 Pinterest内容重新本土化。
en: Many hit posts on Xiaohongshu are essentially just foreign Pinterest content re-localised.

text: 国外流行的"安静离职"低欲望生活",国内改个名字又是一波流量。
en: The 'quiet quitting' low-desire lifestyle popular abroad gets renamed in China and becomes another wave of traffic.

text: 很多人以为赚钱靠能力，其实很多时候靠"谁先知道".
en: Many people think making money depends on ability, but often it actually depends on 'who knows first'.

text: 有人专门做国外AI工具测评，接广告接到手软。
en: Some people specialise in reviewing foreign AI tools and get so many advertising deals they cannot keep up.

text: 国外爆火的儿童感统训练，在国内很多家长还没听过。
en: Sensory-integration training for children, which is booming abroad, is something many parents in China have not even heard of.

text: 国外宠物殡葬已经产业化，国内很多城市才刚刚开始。
en: Pet funeral services have already become an industry abroad, while many cities in China are only just getting started.

text: 有人把国外菜谱翻译成"减脂版中国胃"，一年卖了几万份。
en: Someone translated foreign recipes into a 'fat-loss version for the Chinese stomach' and sold tens of thousands of copies in a year.

text: 国外妈妈博主的育儿话术，翻译后在国内情感赛道直接起号。
en: Parenting scripts from foreign mum bloggers, once translated, can launch an account directly in China's emotional-content niche.

text: 很多人天天焦虑失业，但真正赚钱的人，都在研究"国外已经验证过的模式".
en: Many people worry about unemployment every day, but the people who really make money are all studying 'models already proven abroad'.

text: 国外火了3年的东西，国内可能才刚刚开始。
en: Something that has been popular abroad for three years may only just be starting in China.

text: 有人专门搬国外冥想音乐，挂助眠产品，一年利润几十万。
en: Some people specialise in moving foreign meditation music, attach sleep-aid products, and make hundreds of thousands of yuan in profit a year.

text: 国外二手奢侈品市场特别成熟，很多人低价收回来国内转卖。
en: The foreign second-hand luxury market is especially mature; many people buy low abroad and resell in China.

text: 很多县城老板，连ChatGPT是什么都不知道。
en: Many small-city bosses do not even know what ChatGPT is.

text: 有人把国外老年健身操翻译成中文版，在中老年赛道疯狂吸粉。
en: Someone translated foreign senior fitness routines into a Chinese version and wildly gained followers in the middle-aged and elderly niche.

text: 国外流行的家庭整理师，在国内已经开始有人月入十万。
en: Family organisers, popular abroad, are already earning some people 100,000 yuan a month in China.

text: 你以为自己在卷同行，其实真正的机会在"跨国家复制".
en: You think you are competing with your peers, but the real opportunity lies in 'cross-country replication'.

text: 有人专门翻译国外商业访谈，剪成短视频，卖老板认知课。
en: Some people specialise in translating foreign business interviews, cutting them into short videos, and selling boss-mindset courses.

text: 很多国外免费的PDF资料，在国内重新包装就能卖钱。
en: Many free foreign PDF resources, repackaged in China, can be sold for money.

text: 国外做"情绪价值"的产业已经极度成熟，国内才刚开始爆发。
en: The 'emotional value' industry abroad is already extremely mature, while in China it is only just beginning to explode.

text: 有人把国外儿童绘本做成AI动画，家长疯狂买单。
en: Someone turned foreign children's picture books into AI animations, and parents buy them like crazy.

text: 国外早就成熟的"个人IP+社群+订阅制"，国内还很多人在靠一次性卖货。
en: The mature foreign model of 'personal IP + community + subscription' is still unfamiliar in China, where many people still rely on one-off sales.

text: 很多人总觉得"这个早有人做了".
en: Many people always think 'someone already did this'.

text: 但问题是，中国太大了。
en: But the problem is, China is too big.

text: 你知道，不代表别人知道。
en: You knowing something does not mean others know it.

text: 有人把国外流行穿搭做成"150斤女生版"，瞬间精准爆流量。
en: Someone turned popular foreign outfits into a 'version for 150-jin girls' and instantly hit precisely targeted viral traffic.

text: 国外很多低成本创业项目，在国内甚至还没人讲。
en: Many low-cost foreign startup projects have not even been talked about in China yet.

text: 互联网最赚钱的，从来不是原创，而是"高级搬运".
en: The most profitable thing on the internet has never been originality, but 'high-level moving'.

text: 有人专门研究国外老头老太太的退休生活视频，卖银发旅游产品。
en: Someone specialises in studying videos of foreign retirees' lives and sells silver-hair tourism products.

text: 37.TikTok上很多几千万播放的视频，搬到视频号依然能爆。
en: 37. Videos with tens of millions of views on TikTok can still go viral when moved to Channels.

text: 有人把国外儿童专注力训练做成打印资料包，一个月卖几千单。
en: Someone turned foreign children's focus training into printable material packs, selling thousands of orders a month.

text: 真正赚钱的人，从来不是最努力的人，而是最会"借信息差"的人。
en: The people who really make money are never the hardest-working people, but the best at 'borrowing information gaps'.

text: 大部分普通人，一辈子都困在自己的生活半径里。
en: Most ordinary people spend their whole lives trapped within their own living radius.

text: 他们不知道国外在流行什么，不知道别的城市在赚钱什么，也不知道互联网到底有多少机会。
en: They do not know what is trending abroad, what people in other cities are making money from, or how many opportunities the internet actually holds.

text: 所以很多人越穷越焦虑，越焦虑越刷短视频，最后彻底失去信息获取能力。
en: So many people grow poorer and more anxious, and the more anxious they get, the more short videos they scroll, until they completely lose the ability to obtain information.

text: 这个时代最值钱的能力，不是吃苦。
en: The most valuable ability of this era is not enduring hardship.

text: 而是：
en: It is:

text: 获取信息，
en: Obtaining information,

text: 筛选信息，
en: Filtering information,

text: 重组信息，
en: Recombining information,

text: 再卖给信息落后的人。
en: And selling it to people who are behind on information.

text: 这世界上，95%的财富都藏在信息差里。
en: 95% of the world's wealth is hidden in information gaps.

text: 中国有13亿人口，10亿人没坐过飞机。
en: China has 1.3 billion people, and 1 billion of them have never flown on a plane.

text: 信息差大到超乎想象。
en: The information gap is bigger than you can imagine.
